pr_title: [Merged by Bors] - Add AND/OR combinators for run conditions
pr_body:
# Objective

Fix #7584.

## Solution

Add an abstraction for creating custom system combinators with minimal boilerplate. Use this to implement AND/OR combinators. Use this to simplify the implementation of `PipeSystem`.

## Example

Feel free to bikeshed on the syntax.

I chose the names `and_then`/`or_else` to emphasize the fact that these short-circuit, while I chose method syntax to empasize that the arguments are *not* treated equally.

```rust
app.add_systems((
    my_system.run_if(resource_exists::<R>().and_then(resource_equals(R(0)))),
    our_system.run_if(resource_exists::<R>().or_else(resource_exists::<S>())),
));
```

---

## Todo

- [ ] Decide on a syntax
- [x] Write docs
- [x] Write tests

## Changelog

+ Added the extension methods `.and_then(...)` and `.or_else(...)` to run conditions, which allows combining run conditions with short-circuiting behavior.
+ Added the trait `Combine`, which can be used with the new `CombinatorSystem` to create system combinators with custom behavior.
pr_comments: @alice-i-cecile @inodentry I'd appreciate your opinions on the syntax used here :)
Milestone placement is "we should make a call on this", not "this must be included". I think there's a lot of value here, but it's also a little tricky.

Why doesn't `pipe` use this combinator pattern?

I'd like us to avoid proliferating unsafe system implementations.

Two? is already too many, can we avoid it growing to three?

> Why doesn't pipe use this combinator pattern?

It does.
Ah, the dangers of trying to do code review on my phone. My apologies.

> (I also believe that they're not sound)

It's unsound in the same way that every other `System` impl is (has no guarantees that it's running on the correct `World`). I've been meaning to open a PR to address this.
I've added documentation and examples, simplified the `Combine` trait, and documented the previously-implicit safety invariants in `impl System for CombinatorSystem`.

> I chose the names and_then/or_else to emphasize the fact that these short-circuit, while I chose method syntax to empasize that the arguments are not treated equally.

Maybe use `and` and `or`? Shorter and a little more readable as to me.

Personally I prefer `and_then`/`or_else` for the reasons I mentioned in the PR desc -- I think that making the behavior clear is more important than making the name short. I'm willing to change it if there's a consensus for those names (or any other) though, of course.
I think it could be good if there were an added example of usage under `examples/ecs`. There might already be a suitable .rs file
From what I can tell, none of our examples use run conditions at all (except for `.on_update()`). We should address this, but IMO there should be a separate issue for this.

Will it be possible to combine multiple conditions with this syntax?..

For example something like `A && B || C && D`?
I think it's very useful if you have substaces. For example, in my game I run `PlacingObjectPlugin::movement_system` in `GameState::City` with substate `CityMode::Objects` **and** in `GameState::Family` with substate `FamilyMode::Building`. Currently I have to add my system twice ([1](https://github.com/dollisgame/dollis/blob/98ddab5d74d25109f9b022e4d0a14381ffba1bc9/src/core/object/placing_object.rs#L49-L52), [2](https://github.com/dollisgame/dollis/blob/98ddab5d74d25109f9b022e4d0a14381ffba1bc9/src/core/object/placing_object.rs#L94-L97), the game currenly uses loopless, but will be similar with stageless).
Yes, that should be possible. `and_then` and `or_else` return run conditions, so you should be able to keep adding as many combinators as you want.
Can you add these to the example from #7652 once it's merged?
I've added `and_then` to the example, but I'm really struggling to think of a way to show off `or_else` that isn't extremely contrived.

issue_context.title: Add OR and AND combinators for system run conditions
issue_context.body:
> I suspected that the only way to make an OR-combinator might be using a custom System impl, and now you confirmed it. So, I think it's out of scope for this PR.

Agreed. I'd like both OR and AND combinators (to follow-up #7559), but that's out of scope here.

_Originally posted by @alice-i-cecile in https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/issues/7579#issuecomment-1424683773_
comments: Just to clarify the behavior of these combinators, they should short-circuit, right? A non-short-circuiting AND combinator would be fairly useless, since you could achieve the same effect by just calling `.run_if()` multiple times.
Yeah, short-circuiting is essential. And should have non-surprising behavior (barring interior mutability) because run conditions are read-only.
In that case, I think it would be good to call these `and_then`/`or_else`, in order to emphasize the fact that they short circuit.

review_comments:
Doc strings and doc tests here :)

I really like that these are methods though!
Should this be restricted to ReadOnlySystem?
Not necessary, `CombinatorSystem<A, B, AndThenMarker>` only implements `ReadOnlySystem` if `A` and `B` do, so the trait bounds "just work" as is.

```suggestion
    unsafe fn combine(
```
in lieu of `a: impl unsafe FnOnce`

I ended up rewriting this trait and the way it's used, so this suggestion doesn't apply anymore. I also added comments for the relevant safety invariants, which should hopefully be more convincing now.
